description: In front of you are stacked plastic plates in green, yellow, red, and blue, a scatter of colorful plastic cutlery, a blue sponge on the left, and a yellow squeeze bottle on the right. The left hand steadies the top green plate while the right hand grips and pulls the red plate up and to the right, separating it from the stack and setting it down; then both hands move inward to gather and bunch the loose cutlery into a neater pile in the center.
